easyPrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk or Smaug.
You control a Treasure.
description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Smaug the Magnificent as attackers.
Smaug the Magnificent triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Bruce Banner // The Incredible Hulk
uses.cardState: as The Incredible Hulk and without summoning sickness
